summary: Tested the full backend (27 pytest cases) and the main UI flows end to end. The backend passes 26 of 27 tests. One real bug: saving an actual cost of 0 does not mark costs as recorded. These all work: create and validation for both job types; job numbers (sequential, 10 concurrent creates gave unique numbers); edits with history; delete and restore (job number and history kept, Record entries added); filters; dashboard; overdue rule, including the exact 7-day boundary; reports, including payment buckets and leaving deleted jobs out; settings. UI checks that passed: live calculation and discount/advance errors on both forms; redirect to job detail after save; edit, status change, costs and history tabs; status change on a Work Management card; status, category and search filters; delete dialog, Recycle Bin and restore; print page shows the shop name and customer-facing fields only, with no actual cost or profit; all 6 report tabs; settings shop name showing on the print page; dashboard KPIs; mobile layout.

minor.issue: Saving actual costs of 0 (for example actual_production_cost=0) leaves costs_recorded=false. Cause: compute() sets actual_* to 0 by default at creation, so the update finds no changed fields and returns early at 'if not entries' before costs_recorded is saved. The UI still shows 'Costs saved' but the job still reads 'Actual costs not entered' and is left out of profit.
CONTACT_RE ^[0-9+\-\s]{7,15}$ accepts values with no digits, such as '+-- -- --'. Consider requiring 7-15 actual digits.

integration_issues.issue: Request results can arrive out of order: there is no stale-response guard or AbortController in load(). Not reproduced on retest, but quickly switching filters could show the wrong list.

issues: The first cost entry shows the old value as ₹0.00 although costs were never entered. Should show '—'.
Uses the browser's native input type=date/month instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover picker.
Sonner toasts at top-right cover the Status/Print/Delete header buttons for a few seconds after each save.

action_items: Fix update_job so that sending any actual_* key sets costs_recorded=true and saves it even when values do not change, e.g. compute the costs_recorded flip before the 'if not entries' early return, or add a 'Costs Recorded' history entry.
Optional: make contact validation require 7-15 digits.
Optional: show '—' for old values on the first cost entry; add a stale-response guard in WorkManagement.load; consider the shadcn date picker.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_job: the early return when nothing changed skips saving costs_recorded (root cause of the zero-cost bug).
next_job_number uses today's year, not the job date. That matches the spec (sequence restarts each calendar year) and the unique index plus retry loop prevents duplicates.
list_jobs and dashboard load up to 5000/10000 docs into memory. Fine for a single shop, but there is no pagination.
seed_data_creation: None kept. All TEST_ jobs were deleted from db.jobs; the job counter advanced (to about SST-2026-106); settings were restored to defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest /app/backend/tests/test_sst_jobs.py (pytest.ini forces -n 2 loadscope; cleanup deletes only ids created by each worker). test_zero_costs_recorded is the known failing regression test. The browser clock is Nov 2026.
